Trump posts AI video of Kharg island 'blown to smithereens'

Former US President Donald Trump posted an AI-generated video depicting Iran's Kharg oil terminal being 'blown to smithereens'. The video was shared on his Truth Social platform. Trump's post came amid heightened tensions and followed reports of Iran targeting US bases.
